notes.title: Now Available on Steam - IHF Handball Challenge 14
notes.notes:
IHF Handball Challenge 14 is Now Available on Steam!

Discover the best handball simulation!

Become a handball champion playing the first simulation with 120 official teams from the 3 most prestigious leagues. Play as your favourite players and experience breathless matches with up to 4 players at the same time!

notes.title: IHF Handball Challenge 14 is now available!
notes.notes:
Bigben Interactive and Neutron Games proudly present IHF Handball Challenge 14, the brand new handball simulation.

You will have the pleasure to play with the greatest teams from the greatest Eurpean leagues, including : 

Ligue Nationale de Handball (France)
DKB Handball-Bundesliga (Germany)
Liga ASOBAL (Spain)

You will be able to play with more than 80 clubs plus more than 30 national teams. You will also have the ability to create your own leagues. All these teams will compete in 7 arenas with 7 different types of flooring.

Feel like playing and coaching during a real handball match. You will enjoy a wide variety of realistic moves (shots, passes, defensive moves...) thanks to the motion capture. Plus, the many offence and defence options will make the games tensed and dynamic.
